driver-heading.purpose: Introduce the native driver and car choices. Mobile uses 13px, and short touch landscape uses 14px.

driver-name.purpose: Identify all nine drivers and nine car models in bold Courier New. Roster labels retain 12px text across layouts.

driver-preview-name.purpose: Identify the larger driver and car previews. Mobile uses 14px for drivers and 12px for cars. Short touch landscape uses bold 12px Courier New.

crew-heading.purpose: Introduce the full-body crew scene in pink Arcade text. Mobile uses 24px.

crew-body.purpose: Carry the introduction, horizontal-pan help, and selected driver's description.

vr-heading.purpose: Introduce setup, chapter, pause, failure, and delivery panels. Widths up to 760px use 27px.

vr-body.purpose: Carry setup and state copy beside the 3D preview.

vr-field.purpose: Identify driver, car, paint, and steering choices in native selects.

vr-loadout-caption.purpose: Identify the selected full-body character and car beneath the original artwork.

shadows.name: cabinet
shadows.purpose: Separate the cabinet from the page.

shadows.name: hud-text
shadows.purpose: Protect instrument text over the scene.

shadows.name: countdown-text
shadows.purpose: Keep the countdown distinct from the road.

shadows.name: race-message-text
shadows.purpose: Keep race messages legible over the scene.

motion.name: button-feedback
motion.purpose: Provide short color feedback on buttons. Reduced motion removes the transition.

motion.name: driver-choice-feedback
motion.purpose: Provide border and fill feedback on driver and car choices. Reduced motion removes the transition.

motion.name: world-travel
motion.purpose: Multiply rendered world distance to strengthen the sense of speed.

motion.name: boost-projection
motion.purpose: Ease toward focal length 42 during boost. Normal and reduced-motion views target 55.

motion.name: speed-lines
motion.purpose: Draw peripheral streaks from 160 km/h. Intensity reaches one at 460 km/h. Reduced motion hides them.

motion.name: cameo-cooldown
motion.purpose: The first boost of each run introduces the selected driver. Each cameo starts this cooldown before later boost onsets qualify.

motion.name: cameo-chance
motion.purpose: After the introduction, each eligible boost onset uses this chance to show the selected driver. A held boost does not retrigger the cameo.

motion.name: cameo-sequence
motion.purpose: The selected driver emerges over 0.4s, turns at 0.6s, and smiles at 0.88s. The name tag appears from 0.95s to 1.8s. Return starts at 1.85s and ends at 2.6s.

motion.name: cameo-rise
motion.purpose: Ease the head out of the window. The rise value spans zero to one over 0.4s.

motion.name: cameo-return
motion.purpose: Lower the head over 0.75s. Early boost release advances to this phase.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove decorative travel, streaks, shake, bounce, tilt, flicker, scanlines, and button and driver-choice transitions. Show the selected driver's stationary smile after 0.15s and before 2.25s. Keep gameplay and exhaust active.

motion.name: pit-entry
motion.purpose: Stop the car after deliberate entry into a green shoulder bay, then show the garage conversation. The timer, lane, and distance remain fixed.

motion.name: sunrise-arrival
motion.purpose: Show the selected car at the Omarchy arcade before the completion screen. SEE RESULTS skips the arrival.

motion.name: crew-pan
motion.purpose: Center a full-body figure after a garage name-button action. Reduced motion selects instant scroll.

motion.name: vr-world-scale
motion.purpose: Scale road travel, traffic, and pickup distance in the level VR cockpit.

motion.name: vr-comfort-mask
motion.purpose: Set peripheral mask strength during play when comfort view is enabled. Other states use zero strength.

motion.name: vr-cameo-pose
motion.purpose: Reuse the original back, profile, and smile sequence for the voxel driver. Reduced motion selects the smile pose.

motion.name: vr-simulation-substep
motion.purpose: Limit each engine update within an elapsed VR frame. The adapter includes the final smaller step.

motion.name: vr-frame-limit
motion.purpose: Cap elapsed time per rendered frame before the simulation adapter processes its substeps.

components.name: Driver choice
components.description:
Native radio labels form a 3 × 3 roster. The game adds pixel portrait canvases and a larger selected preview. Left and Right move one choice. Up and Down move three choices. Home and End select the first and last choices.

All nine drivers have back, profile, and smile cameo poses. Bjarne and Spencer use colorized artwork. Hancore uses the skull avatar. Outfoxxed follows the replacement portrait with swept brown hair, silver-framed glasses, a teal shirt, and a dark jacket. Car choices reuse these states with nine distinct silhouettes.
components.css: .ds-driver-roster { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-auto-rows: max-content; align-content: start; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 6px; margin: 0; border: 0; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; text-align: center; } .ds-driver-option { position: relative; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; user-select: none; } .ds-driver-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } .ds-driver-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; height: 100%; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 4px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #343b58); border-radius: 0; background: var(--panel, #24283b); transition: border-color 120ms ease-out, background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-driver-card strong { font: bold 12px/16px 'Courier New', monospace; color: var(--text, #c0caf5); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-driver-option:hover .ds-driver-card { border-color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); } .ds-driver-input:checked + .ds-driver-card { border-color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); background: #2d2c3d; } .ds-driver-input:checked + .ds-driver-card strong { color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-driver-input:focus-visible + .ds-driver-card { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-driver-card { padding: 6px 4px; gap: 5px; } } @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) and (pointer: coarse) { .ds-driver-roster { gap: 6px; } .ds-driver-card { gap: 2px; padding: 4px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-driver-card { transition: none; } }

components.name: Race setup tabs
components.description: DRIVER and CAR & COLOR separate the two setup panels. Left, Right, Home, and End move tab focus. Confirmation persists the driver, car, and paint. Back restores the prior screen and confirmed choices.
components.html:
Your driver makes occasional nitro cameos.
Nine car models. Nine Tokyo Night colors.
components.css: .ds-setup { color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font: 12px/1.8 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-setup-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #343b58); } .ds-setup-tabs button { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font: 12px 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: .5px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-setup-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); border-bottom-color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-setup-tabs button:hover { color: var(--text, #c0caf5); } .ds-setup-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-setup-panel[hidden] { display: none; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-setup-tabs { margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-setup-tabs button { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 14px; } } @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) and (pointer: coarse) { .ds-setup-tabs { margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-setup-tabs button { min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 12px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-setup-tabs button { transition: none; } }

components.html: AMBER · #E0AF68

components.name: Garage crew navigation
components.description:
Name buttons center each full-body figure, update its description, and select its card download. The 1728 × 900 garage canvas draws 48 × 104 sprites at 144 × 312 canvas pixels. Its 1280px minimum artwork width preserves figure size through mobile horizontal pan. Garage scenes use only Omarchy branding.

Nine 1080 × 1080 PNG cards include source provenance. Local copies occupy `exports/cameo-cards/` and `exports/cameo-cards.zip`. Published copies occupy `assets/cameo-cards/` and `assets/cameo-cards.zip`.

The arcade lineup links to `garage.html`. At widths up to 700px, the arcade footer shows a yellow 12px `MEET THE CREW` link. Short touch landscape hides the footer and restores the lineup caption.
components.html:
DHH: Wavy hair and beard.

DOWNLOAD ALL CARDSDOWNLOAD DHH CARD

components.name: Optional pit conversation
components.description: Green shoulder bays and `P` signs identify optional stops at randomized route positions. Passing on the road continues the race. Deliberate entry stops the car before a four-line Omarchy conversation with a crew member other than the selected driver. The timer pauses. `CONTINUE` advances each line. `BACK TO THE RUN` returns to the same lane and distance with a full nitro tank.
components.html:
RYAN

TOKYO NIGHT EVERYWHERE

Omarchy themes style the desktop, terminal, Neovim, and shell together.

1 / 4

components.name: Nitro meter
components.description: The track uses a left-origin fill. The boost class selects yellow feedback. A full tank lasts eight seconds at 12.5 charge per second. Randomized cyan-blue canisters restore 45 charge, capped at 100.
components.html:
NITRO
HOLD TO BOOST
components.css: .ds-nitro { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; text-shadow: 0 2px 4px var(--bg, #16161e); } .ds-nitro-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); letter-spacing: 1px; } .ds-nitro-track { box-sizing: border-box; height: 10px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #565f89; background: var(--night, #1a1b26); } .ds-nitro-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); transform-origin: left; transform: scaleX(.65); } .ds-nitro.ds-boosting .ds-nitro-fill { background: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-nitro-state { display: block; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); letter-spacing: .4px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-nitro-label { margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-nitro-state { margin-top: 7px; letter-spacing: 0; } }

components.name: Checkpoint readout
components.description: A dark backing protects cyan distance and wrapped support text from skyline detail. Four finite 3km chapters require one cassette, two power cells, six passed cars, and a final drive with at most two collisions. An unmet objective at an exit ends the run. A third collision ends the final chapter immediately. Briefings pause the timer, and the mission instrument shows progress and the next drop's lane. A sunrise arrival precedes the completion screen and its `PLAY AGAIN` action.
components.css: .ds-checkpoint-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; container-type: inline-size; } .ds-checkpoint { padding: 10px; background: #1a1b26f5; color: var(--text, #c0caf5); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; text-align: right; text-shadow: 0 2px 4px var(--bg, #16161e); } .ds-checkpoint-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px; } .ds-checkpoint strong { display: block; color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); font-family: 'Arcade', monospace; font-size: clamp(12px, 1.8cqw, 22px); font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-checkpoint small { font: 12px 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-checkpoint-detail { display: block; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); letter-spacing: .4px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-checkpoint { padding: 6px; } .ds-checkpoint-label { margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-checkpoint strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-checkpoint-detail { margin-top: 7px; max-width: 90px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 0; } }

components.name: Keyboard legend
components.description: Outlined keycaps identify physical keys. The deeper bottom border distinguishes them from action buttons.

components.name: VR screen action
components.description: The outlined cyan action starts screen mode and carries chapter, resume, and results actions in the VR setup panel.
components.css: .ds-vr-secondary { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #343b58); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); font: 12px/1.7 'Arcade', monospace; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-vr-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); background: var(--panel, #24283b); } .ds-vr-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-vr-secondary:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-vr-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: VR setup select
components.description: Native selects use panel fill, rectangular borders, and cyan focus. The steering preference demonstrates the shared field style. Setup also shows original full-body and car preview canvases.
components.css: .ds-vr-preferences { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 14px 12px; margin-bottom: 26px; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font: 12px 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-vr-select { min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #343b58); border-radius: 0; background: var(--panel, #24283b); color: var(--text, #c0caf5); font: 14px 'Courier New', monospace; color-scheme: dark; } .ds-vr-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: MP3 song action
components.description: The arcade song action uses an inline SVG and yellow text. The VR header uses text. Play turns the control cyan, and pending requests remain cancellable.
components.css: .ds-song-example { container-type: inline-size; } .ds-song-toolbar { display: flex; min-height: 44px; } .ds-song { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); font: 12px 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: .2px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-song svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-song:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-song[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); } .ds-song:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-song:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } .ds-song-notice { margin: 0; padding: 12px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #343b58); background: var(--bg, #16161e); color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font: 12px/1.7 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-song-notice[data-state='error'] { color: var(--pink, #f7768e); } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-song { min-width: 40px; padding-inline: 3px; justify-content: center; } .ds-song-label { display: none; } } @container (max-width: 600px) { .ds-song { min-width: 40px; padding-inline: 3px; justify-content: center; } .ds-song-label { display: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-song { transition: none; } }

components.name: VR garage toggle
components.description: The button names the destination view. A pressed state marks the active garage. A switch during a drive pauses the race.
components.html: <nav class="ds-vr-controls" aria-label="Cockpit controls"><button class="ds-vr-garage" type="button" aria-label="Show cockpit" aria-pressed="true">COCKPIT</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-vr-controls { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 20px; } .ds-vr-garage { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; gap: 7px; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font: 12px 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: .2px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-vr-garage:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-vr-garage[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); } .ds-vr-garage:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-vr-garage:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-vr-controls { width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 8px; } } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-vr-garage { min-width: 40px; justify-content: center; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-vr-garage { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
An after-hours arcade cabinet frames a Tokyo expressway in hard-edged pixel art. Tokyo Night indigo, neon signs, and a default yellow Lamborghini Countach establish the identity.

A compact instrument interface keeps the road and car prominent. The skyline, road, vehicles, driver portraits, and boost cameos use original procedural artwork. The garage and nine shareable PNG cards reuse the full-body character artwork.

The seated VR cockpit extends this world through low-poly procedural geometry. Arcade text and rectangular instruments connect its 3D road to the pixel arcade.
VR also reuses the original character, car, garage, logo, and sign artwork.
keyCharacteristics: A yellow Countach is the default in the behind-the-car view.
Tokyo Night colors connect the interface and scene.
Pixel titles pair with compact monospace labels.
Rectangular controls frame a responsive canvas.
Nine drivers, nine car silhouettes, and nine official Tokyo Night paints use native radio choices.
Occasional boost cameos feature the selected driver.
Four finite chapters end with a sunrise arrival and completion screen.
Optional green shoulder bays pause the timer for four-line Omarchy conversations.
The original Omarchy text-block logo marks the start screen and roadside signs.
Cliamp roadside advertisements pair the verified wordmark with spectrum bars.
The linked crew lineup opens an Omarchy garage with full-body figures and horizontal pan.
Nine square PNG cameo cards share the original full-body artwork.
A level, head-tracked cockpit carries the same palette into stereo WebXR.
Original browser artwork connects the VR garage, cockpit occupants, roadside scenes, and final arcade.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Use the same Tokyo Night accents in the interface and the procedural scene.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Use Arcade for titles, primary actions, and main instrument values. Use Courier New for supporting labels and instructions.

dos: Do preserve the default yellow Countach and behind-the-car pixel view.
Do share the Tokyo Night palette between interface controls and procedural artwork.
Do keep the full road width and visible touch controls through responsive and fullscreen states.
Do preserve focus outlines, text-backed status, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do preserve the supplied Omarchy text-block logo on the start screen and roadside signs.
Do keep pit stops optional through deliberate entry into a marked shoulder bay.
Do preserve the wide garage scene and figure size through horizontal pan on mobile.
Do keep source provenance in exported PNG artwork.
donts: Don't smooth the pixel artwork or replace its hard-edged geometry with photographic imagery.
Don't replace rectangular arcade controls with pill-shaped controls.
Don't let skyline detail obscure checkpoint information.
Don't repeat the cameo continuously during one held boost.
Don't add Cliamp advertisements to garage scenes.
